title: The Coming UFO Disclosure: A Government-Fabricated Cosmic False Flag?

Intelligence sources suggest this coordinated religious outreach mirrors COVID-era information management tactics, raising critical questions about whether genuine disclosure is finally occurring or whether a manufactured "cosmic false flag" operation is being deployed to serve undisclosed government objectives.

title: Pentagon Declassifies More UFO Sightings Though No Sight Of Little Green Space Dudes

description: The Department of War has released its initial batch of declassified UAP files, marking the first official document dump from the military's most secretive branch. title: Declassified Apollo moon docs describe unexplained mysteries, UFO lights 'like the Fourth of July'

title: UFO investigator warns Trump disclosure could hand sensitive military secrets to China, Russia

title: Pentagon declassifies UFO files
description: The Pentagon has released hundreds of previously classified UFO documents containing military encounter reports, NASA communications, and intelligence assessments collected over decades of official secrecy. title: UFO whistleblowers issue chilling warning after Air Force officer was found dead before testimony
description: Air Force whistleblowers report escalating threats and suspicious deaths targeting UAP disclosure witnesses, following the death of an officer scheduled to provide classified testimony.
